title: Preservation of bounded states
statement: Let a statement execute under limits, program $P$, and depth $d$, from state $\sigma$ to state $\sigma'$ with cost $c$. If every location and memory value in $\sigma$ has absolute value at most the word limit, then every location and memory value in $\sigma'$ also has absolute value at most the word limit.
